title: Rewrite of Title 19 county zoning code
summary: On July 15, the planning commission heard a briefing on the Title 19 zoning code rewrite, and staff said the first module of draft chapters should reach the commission later this summer or fall. The County Council, not the commission, has final say on zoning changes. The rewrite began in 2019 and is not finished; chapters will come in modules, and housing types are a main focus.
